The previously attempted static straddling rider with huge shoulders/hands is rejected: do NOT invent that.
Retain the original energetic pose: slender elf leaning naturally with his white horse, long blond hair sweeping behind, curved sword raised to the side, other hand holding reins, blue/gold armour with the SAME gold eight-spoked sun emblem as image 2, ivory cloak. Keep balanced adult shoulders, slim torso, natural arm thickness, normal sized hands and boots. NO massive bodybuilder shoulders, boxing-glove fists, tiny pin head, enormous chest or decorative topknot. Match original character instead of a generic armoured rider.
STRICT anatomy: the human RIDER ALONE, if unseated and stood upright, is exactly FIVE heads tall (not four, not six-plus). Clear saddle seat and hips, thighs naturally around saddle, bent knees, normal calves and boots in stirrups. Do not show an extra rider boot or extra hand, no floating saddle. The face points down with chin gently tucked, not toward viewer. Do not turn to eye-level front portrait or side view, and do not exaggerate into a vertical overhead camera. Preserve original's dynamic pose and natural body relationships.
Polished dense PIXEL ART, stepped pixel edges, controlled colours, compact shaded clusters; match original game art, not smooth 3D or generic glossy illustration. One isolated complete mounted unit on genuine transparent alpha, no base disc, ground shadow, text or extra figure. All weapon, cloak and feet inside frame.
